text: Supports multiple databases (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and more) for storing auth data
quote: You can easily configure Better Auth to use SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, and more!

text: Built-in email and password authentication support
quote: Better Auth provides built-in authentication support for: Email and password

text: Client SDK method to sign up users with email, password, name, and image
quote: const { data, error } = await authClient.signUp.email({ email, password, name, image, callbackURL: "/dashboard" }

text: Supports multiple social/OAuth login providers including Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord
quote: Better Auth supports multiple social providers, including Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord, and more.

text: Two-factor authentication with backup codes for account recovery
quote: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra security step when users log in... Generating backup codes for account recovery

text: JWT plugin exposes endpoints to issue JWTs and a JWKS endpoint for verification
quote: The JWT plugin provides endpoints to retrieve a JWT token and a JWKS endpoint to verify the token.

text: Provides a guided migration path from Auth0 covering passwords, social accounts, and 2FA
quote: we'll walk through the steps to migrate a project from Auth0 to Better Auth — including email/password with proper hashing, social/external accounts, two-factor authentication, and more.

text: Supports non-destructive rotation of the auth secret without downtime or DB migration
quote: Better Auth supports non-destructive rotation of `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET`... No database migrations or downtime are required.

text: Users can revoke their own sessions to log out of other devices/browsers
quote: A logged in user can also revoke their own sessions to log out from different devices or browsers.

text: Built-in configurable rate limiter to prevent abuse of auth endpoints
quote: You can easily customize these settings by passing the rateLimit object to the betterAuth function.

text: MCP plugin lets an app act as an OAuth authorization server/protected resource for MCP clients
quote: The MCP plugin lets your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for Model Context Protocol clients.

text: Organization plugin manages org members, teams, and access/permissions
quote: The organization plugin allows you to manage your organization's members and teams. Organizations simplifies user access and permissions management.

text: SSO plugin supports OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0 identity providers
quote: This plugin supports OpenID Connect (OIDC), OAuth2 providers, and SAML 2.0.

text: Admin plugin lets admins create users, manage roles, ban/unban, and impersonate users
quote: It allows administrators to perform various operations such as creating users, managing user roles, banning/unbanning users, impersonating users, and more.

text: API Key plugin lets you create and manage API keys to authenticate/authorize API requests
quote: The API Key plugin allows you to create and manage API keys for your application. It provides a way to authenticate and authorize API requests by verifying API keys.

text: Device Authorization plugin implements OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for TVs, CLIs, IoT devices
quote: The Device Authorization plugin implements the code issuance and approval flow from the OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant (RFC 8628) for limited-input devices such as smart TVs, CLI applications, IoT devices, and gaming consoles.

text: Hosts a remote MCP server exposing docs search, examples, and setup help to MCP clients like Cursor and Claude Code
quote: Better Auth hosts a remote MCP server that exposes documentation search, examples, and setup help to any MCP-capable client (Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, Open Code, and others).

text: First-party integration support for Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ other frameworks
quote: Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Astro, Hono, and 20+ more.

text: Server-side auth.api methods let you authenticate users programmatically
quote: To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.

text: CLI tool can test/exercise the device authorization flow
quote: You can test the device authorization flow right now using the Better Auth CLI

text: Built-in credential auth with sessions, email verification, and password reset included
quote: Built-in credential auth. Sessions, email verification, and password reset included.

text: Configurable session expiry and rolling update-age for session refresh
quote: session: { expiresIn: 60 * 60 * 24 * 7, updateAge: 60 * 60 * 24 }

text: 2FA can use TOTP authenticator apps by default or OTP via email/SMS
quote: totp (default) sets up an authenticator app... otp enables email/SMS-based codes immediately

text: Supports passkeys, magic links, API keys, and JWTs as sign-in/auth methods
quote: Passkeys, magic links, API keys, JWTs, and more.

text: Auth configuration lives entirely in version-controlled, type-safe code rather than a hosted dashboard
quote: No dashboard clicks. Your auth lives in code version controlled, type-safe, and reviewable in PRs.
